head: e0f82108183ceff1aeb9c8721720b68726d23c23
supported_or_disproved_claims: Raw bases and modifiers survive actual packet decoding and updateAttributes; neither dependency models nor helper clamps the final value.
Negative modifier totals -1 cause both predicates to accept a target 0.5 blocks away despite effective vanilla range 0.
Overflow totals 100 cause both predicates to accept targets 70 blocks away despite effective vanilla range 64. Normal total 5 provides a passing control.

Vanilla 1.21.1 source sends raw base/modifiers, clamps effective attribute after operations and consumes effective value in reach getters; official NeoForge 1.21.4 docs independently list both [0,64] bounds.

supported_or_disproved_claims: Current package.json directs consumers to src/index.d.ts; its ClientOptions omit brand/cookies/knownPacks and Client omits _cookies. Fresh remote declaration blob matches the exercised file.

Independent TypeScript 5.9.3 consumer compile resolves the actual current-head declaration: baseline createClient compiles; brand, cookies object, cookies Map and knownPacks each emit TS2353; previousClient._cookies emits TS2339.
_cookies is explicitly documented as the transfer-seeding API; the underscore does not make this an unsolicited request to expose an undocumented internal field.

head: 4c2502419e916aec7cba4e5f2005d745ef30eae0
supported_or_disproved_claims: Actual WorldView resolves pale_oak_planks and decorated_pot from 1.21.4 dropped-item metadata; their missing or unsupported texture entries leave the registered current Item group empty.
After repeated metadata and movement, the same empty group persists and no pixel/texture loads are scheduled; no later retry or fallback rescues it.

Actual base renderer retains one drawable fallback geometry for both items; current renderer has zero. Supported oak_planks control schedules pixel/texture loads and produces one actual THREE geometry.
The PR explicitly promises prior behavior for items without textures; this completed-known-stack failure differs from earlier pending-stack movement and disposal findings.

skill_contributions.prismarine-review: Read fresh full patch/body/discussion, checked promised fallback contract and distinctness; matched tested current/base source and released asset index to remote Git blobs.
skill_contributions.prismarine-behavior-test-review: Built an independent production WorldView-to-base/current Entities-to-Item check using actual THREE geometry, including supported-item positive control and repeated updates.
skill_contributions.prismarine-architecture-review: Traced registration and lifetime of empty item groups and checked that asset prerender copies the released index directly, without normalizing unsupported entries.

validation.dependencies: THREE 0.128.0; released minecraft-assets 1.17.0 index, supported viewer 1.21.4; registry through minecraft-data 3.114.0

limits: No WebGL or vanilla server; loaders and TWEEN controlled. Geometry, WorldView metadata routing, Entities and Item production code are real.
Supported-item control uses synthetic opaque pixel data and actual THREE.Texture; it establishes functioning allocation path, not visual image fidelity.
